‌

Name: Chapel of Zenithar
Notes:
As a tribute to Zenithar's hard work efforts, the inside and outside of the Chapel resembles a bazaar. The pews are replaced by shopping stalls, and traveling radiant merchants (only) make stops. Run by Primate Dimitrius Lex, a great war veteran who prefers being indoors most days. The exterior natural crypt is also kept by the priests. The primate has a small smithing setup in the undercroft where he likes to work in his spare time. An anvil, workbench and grindstone. Fire forge would not be well insulated underground.

More info https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V7vH-OIT2njVi0XCoWCAPoAXpxkh1bX41L6fRrXfSao/edit?tab=t.0

-Clara's jewelry

-Roaming merchant

-Roaming merchant

Characters: 

-Primate Dimitrius Lex. Veteran Legate of the Great War. A tall and thick bearded middle aged Imperial man. Some say he even resembles Zenithar himself. A hardy, jolly man who's always been drawn to Zenithar due to his own love of work and reward. The chapel is his proudest achievement, and loves waking up every day to the smells and sounds of talent and skill. Maybe has a bit of unprocessed PTSD that can be just slightly alluded to in dialogue or an ambient quest. Has a smithing station in the undercroft.

-Zaro-ja. Initiate. A timid Khajiit merchant who is a recovering Skooma addict. He currently lives and works at the chapel as his second chance at a better life. He sells the same sort of miscellaneous wares that a Khajiit caravan would, but with significantly less stock. He is grateful to the chapel for giving him this chance when there was probably nowhere else in Tamriel that would. 

-Clara Eontius. Priest. Older woman who has been serving at Chapel Zenithar for the longest by far, and is extremely devout. Has been crafting jewelry as a hobby her entire life, and so has developed a special talent, much like a nun might knit or be a nurse. Sells one of every Divine amulet except Talos, which the player can persuade her to make for them through standard dialogue. She has 3 Zenithar amulets in stock typically instead of 1. 

-Gora gra-Bazrush. Priest. Elderly Orc lady. From a very Imperialized and Divine-loving Orc family that has been serving in chapels for many generations. Aggressive kindness. The bad cop to Clara's good cop. 
-Miraj the Cleric. Mercenary. Stoic cleric. Wears a helmet that hides face, very scarred and bruised face underneath. Hangs out inside the chapel and sleeps on a humble bedroll somewhere? An honorable person who wishes to fight for the betterment of Tamriel, and not to add to the discord. Hireling. Won't accept if the player has a bounty. The most interesting parts of him happen if the player breaks the law with him as a follower. He will give them a chance to attone and help them through the process of regaining honor, or, in a last resort, will attack the player.

Name: Larynia's House
Notes:
The home of a middle class Bosmer cartographer who spends most of her time working from home. Only ever leaving her house to visit the market. Due to her absent-minded nature, she often forgets to lock the front door to her house. Making it a prime target for thieves with an attention to detail. The majority of her house is pretty generic as far as middle class houses go, but she does have one room specifically designed to act as her workshop. This room is filled with maps, rolls of paper, and other instruments a cartographer might use. MCHouse01

Name: Dreams of Dune
Notes:
"The Khajiit don't put much stock in the traditional idea of taverns, favoring their cultural equivalent - the tea house." Upperclass inn owned by Lharlo-dro, an old male Khajiit, and his son, Da'drassa. The inn is very Khajiiti in style as Lharlo-dro is from Dune originally. He lives with and runs the inn with his one son. The inn centers around a type of zen garden with many ornate pillows, paintings of warmer climates, and fireplaces around. Display cases with many gems and fineries and banners adorn the interior. The ground floor is typically spacious and cozy. Khajiit come to buy drinks, typically not alcoholic. Tea houses will often have rooms available above the ground floor. In the basement floor, there'll be a lunging room and a small shrine to the moons. One of the upstairs rooms is permanently occupied by Saril, a Bosmer assassin. UCHouse03

Ignores-The-Sun wanders in and out of Leyawiin as she pleases, hunting in Blackwood with her three dogs -  Anameesh (yellow Nibenese retriever), Ukameesh (black Nibenese retriever), and Banameesh (Colovian shepherd). Name: Leyawiin Synod Conclave
Notes:
Wealthier of the Synod conclave, and more trusted than most, many of its members are active in the community, either politically, or in more subtle ways. Jonoreus Decimius was the First Adjunct initially but is revealed to have been possessed by a spirit during the recommendation quest and has been acting peculiar recently. Ra'Daba is the new First Adjunct and takes over after, but is much more sensible. Renaud takes over as First Adjunct after. She goes on to become one of the new Synod Council after the questline. Eleedal-Kai and Jo'kani like to mingle with the younger and more raucous Khajiit and Argonians in the city, and Jo'kani is often spending time at the Sugar parlor, using his Illusion magic to enhance the experience for nightly attendees. This hall is the main alchemy hall for the Synod. UCHouseSYN

Name: The Nibenese Mystic
Notes: Felara Letero is an Imperial woman in her late 50's. She owns The Nibenese Mystic store in Leyawiin. Originally from an upper middle class home in the Imperial City, she disliked her commercial and scholarly upbringing, preferring to explore and learn things intuitively. That said, once she was old enough to leave home, she joined the Synod in Cheydinhal. A few months ago, she hired an employee/apprentice to teach and to have help out around the shop. Onahsja is an Argonian female in her 50s. She is the apprentice and employee of Felera Letero at The Nibenese Mystic. That, however, is just her day job. She actually moonlights as the necromancer in the caves beneath Castle Leyawiin. An accomplished necromancer with a chip on her shoulder, she took the job in Leyawiin as a front, so she can spend her nights and weekends hunting beggars and animating the corpses of the Argonians tortured to death by Countess Alessia Caro. Once the PC completes the ambient quest related to said caves, they will encounter her there. MCHouse03

Notes:
An extremely popular newspaper company founded in 4E 37 by an Argonian, a Khajiit, and an Imperial, who were former dock workers who didn't trust the growing propaganda of the Black Horse Courier and supported Leyawiin Independence from the Empire. Nowadays it is run by the Elderly Nibenese man Vormaius Noprio who is the last of the line of the Imperial who started the paper, and most of the staff are younger upstart Khajiit and Argonians. Sponsored by the Countyship of Leyawiin. UCHouse03

Name: Plotius Residence
Notes: Upper class home belonging to the Plotius family, a family involved with Leyawiin's advisory council. All of its members are magically gifted, except the family's father, Ticegren, who is self conscious about this and uses magical boosts from Wraithbite to create the outward appearance that he is just as skilled as his wife and daughters. This combined with the powerful high he feels from it has caused Ticegren to become addicted to it, which is costing the family a lot of money. Ticegren and Larexedia's oldest daughter Volraea is a young adult who is preparing to move to the Imperial City to become a battlemage now that she has been accepted by the Arcane University. Their youngest daughter Pelania is still a child, though she wishes to follow in her family's footsteps as she grows older and is already somewhat of a child prodigy. Ticegren and Larexedia are secretly members of the Followers of Oveccia. Their daughters are unaware of this, however Volraea is suspicious of her parents' frequent disappearances. MCHouse03

Middle class home of the manager of the local East Empire Company office. Uren works directly for the EEC owner and considers himself very important. Involved in the Belaboring the Port/Company Man and Walk of Life quests. MCHouse01

Name: Reelo-Shei's House
Notes:
LCHouse01 Lower class home of Reelo-Shei, the unofficial foreman of Leyawiin's dockworkers.

Reelo-Shei is an argonian in his late 20's originally from the Cheydinhal area, from a family of farm workers, he moved to Leyawiin a few years ago in the hopes that he would be treated well and could take advantage of economic opportunities. Unfortunately, that turned out not to be the case.

Despite his industriousness and intelligence, he had little education, and the only opportunity that he found was working as a longshoreman for the EEC. The long hours, however, don't pay off as well as he had hoped, and all the EEC will pay him is scrip. He had managed to get Marcel Laurent to take scrip from the workers and exchange it for septims at the EEC (since the workers themselves are not able to do this), but Uren Virenthri has recently caught wind of this and raised the exchange rate for the scrip.

Now Reelo-Shei and his fellow workers have again found themselves at a distinct disadvantage, and as a sort of leader among the dockworkers, has been attempting to both advocate for them, and prevent them from outright rebellion against the EEC, which would almost certainly end badly for them.
